Structures in PIF: Standardized JSON for Biological Data

Source: vignettes/structs.Rmd
structs.Rmd

Introduction

The PIFDataModel package is designed to standardize data storage and handling for biological studies, particularly focusing on structured JSON schemas. This vignette provides an overview of the available data structures, their purposes, and examples of how to access and utilize them.

Structures Categories

Below is an overview of the structures included in the PIFDataModel package:

Category Description Link
Bacteria Contains the count data for bacteria View
Contains the essays related to bacteria research View
Stores general results from bacteria-related studies View
Contains prevalence results for bacteria View
FAO Contains information about FAO areas View
Food Contains characteristics of food View
Describes the structure of different food types View
Nematodes Contains count results for nematodes View
Contains essays related to nematodes View
Provides food-related information for nematodes View
Contains general results from nematode studies View
Contains essay data for nematode identification View
Contains essay data for nematode infectivity View
Contains results related to nematode infection View
Contains prevalence results for nematodes View
Contains essay data on nematode sample preparation View
Defines the subtype tree for nematodes View
Describes the nematode types in a hierarchical structure View
Protozoans Contains enumeration results for protozoans View
Contains essays related to protozoans View
Stores general results from protozoan studies View
Contains essay data for protozoan identification View
Contains essay data for protozoan infectivity View
Contains results related to protozoan infection View
Contains prevalence results for protozoans View
Contains essay data on protozoan sample preparation View
Defines the subtype classification for protozoans View
Describes the protozoan types in a hierarchical structure View
Lists the measurement units used for protozoan data View
Study Contains structural data for study schema View
Virus Contains enumeration results for viruses View
Contains essays related to virus research View
Stores general results from virus studies View
Contains essay data for virus identification View
Contains essay data for virus infectivity View
Contains results related to virus infection View
Contains results for virus quality and molecular analysis View
Defines the subtype classification for viruses View
Describes the virus types in a hierarchical structure View

Examples

Here are examples of how to load and work with the structures in R:

Loading the PIFDataModel Package 

# Load the PIFDataModel package
library(PIFDataModel)

Accessing the Bacteria Count Data Struct 

library(jsonlite)
# Load the JSON struct
bacteria_struct <- jsonlite::read_json("../inst/extdata/structs/bacteria_count_results.json")

# Print the struct
print(bacteria_struct)
